name: Autosave
description: Automatically saves your game on a schedule you pick in OPTIONS: ON EVENTS (after catching a Pokemon, a level up, an evolution, or a trainer/gym battle), EVERY 5 MIN (a timed autosave), or OFF. Saves are deferred to the moment you are back in free-roam overworld so one never lands mid-battle, and use the engine's own save routine. A brief AUTOSAVED indicator confirms each save. No engine files touched, no maps edited.
